blocks.text: Do coils qareeb rakhi hain (Fig 17.20). Aik, jo switch S aur rheostat ke zariye battery se juri hai, primary coil hai; doosri, jo galvanometer se juri hai, secondary coil hai. Agar rheostat badal kar primary ka current badla jaye to gird ke ilaqe ka magnetic flux badalta hai. Kyunke secondary primary ke magnetic field mein hai, badalta flux secondary se bhi guzarta aur us mein emf paida hota hai.

blocks.title: Mutual induction
blocks.text: Mutual induction woh mazhar hai jis mein aik coil ka badalta current doosri coil mein emf paida karta hai.

blocks.alt: Primary coil, jo switch aur battery ke zariye rheostat se juri hai (current Ip), secondary coil ke saath sire se sira rakhi hai jo galvanometer se juri hai (current Is). Magnetic field lines primary se secondary mein guzarti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.20: Do coils ke darmiyan mutual induction maloom karne ka circuit (kitab ki Figure 17.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Primary ka current badalne par us ka magnetic field badalta hai; yeh field secondary se bhi guzarta hai, is liye secondary mein emf paida hoti aur galvanometer hilta hai. Mustaqil current par field nahi badalta, is liye galvanometer sifar par rehta hai.

Faraday ke qanoon se secondary mein emf es = -Ns d(phis)/dt (17.39), jahan Ns secondary ke chakkaron ki tadaad hai. Secondary se kul flux, Ns phis, primary current ke magnetic field ke mutanasib hai, jo Ip ke mutanasib hai: Ns phis = M Ip (17.40), is liye M = Ns phis / Ip, jahan M dono coils ki mutual inductance hai.

items: Primary aur secondary dono coils ke chakkaron ki tadaad.
Dono coils ke cross-section ka raqba.
Coils ke darmiyan medium ki magnetic permeability.
Woh maddah jis par dono coils lipti hain.
Primary aur secondary coils ka rukh (orientation).

blocks.text: Equation 17.40 se es = -d(Ns phis)/dt = -d(M Ip)/dt, is liye es = -M dIp/dt (17.41). Secondary ki emf primary ke current ki tabdeeli ki sharah ke mutanasib hai, aur manfi nishan batata hai ke yeh primary current ki tabdeeli ki mukhalfat karti hai. Mutual inductance ki miqdar M = es / (dIp/dt) (17.42) hai.

blocks.title: Mutual inductance aur henry
blocks.text: Mutual inductance secondary mein paida aust emf aur primary ke current ki waqti tabdeeli ki sharah ka tanasub hai. Is ki SI ikai V s A^-1, henry (Joseph Henry ke naam par), hai: aik henry do coils ki woh mutual inductance hai jis mein primary ka current aik ampere fi second badalne par secondary mein aik volt emf paida ho.

Mutual inductance transformers, bijli ki motors aur generators mein use hoti hai, signal processing mein kirdar ada karti hai, aur metal detectors jaise aalaat aur jism mein lage pacemakers ko recharge karne mein use hoti hai.

blocks.title: Dimagh ki kasrat: pacemaker kaise kaam karta hai?
blocks.text: Pacemaker jild ke neeche rakha jane wala chhota battery se chalne wala aala hai, jis ki taarein (leads) right atrium aur right ventricle mein jati hain. Yeh dil ke apne bijli ke signals mehsoos karta aur jab dil bohat ahista ya be-qaida dhadke to chhote bijli ke jhatke bhejta hai jo dil ke patthon ko mustaqil raftar se sukarte hain. (Kitab label shuda tasveer dikhati hai.)

Do coils ki mutual inductance 0.2 H hai. Primary ka current 50 A s^-1 ki sharah se badalta hai. Secondary mein paida emf maloom karein. Hal: es = M dIp/dt = 0.2 H x 50 A s^-1 = 10 V (us simt mein jo tabdeeli ki mukhalfat kare).

blocks.prompt: Primary mein mustaqil current behne par secondary mein emf kyun nahi aati?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke emf primary current ki tabdeeli ki sharah par munhasir hai (es = -M dIp/dt); mustaqil current constant flux deta hai, is liye koi tabdeeli aur koi paida emf nahi.

items: Mutual induction: badalta primary current secondary mein emf paida karta.
Ns phis = M Ip; es = -M dIp/dt; ikai henry.
M chakkaron, raqbe, permeability, markaz, faasle aur rukh par munhasir; istemal: transformers, motors, generators, metal detectors.
